title: The flame within the palace of arrogance
intro: Behind the grand walls of the most powerful palace of the ancient world lived a figure whose heart carried a secret that no royal decree could silence. While all around bowed to false gods, this soul kept a quiet faith burning within. The ruler of that land believed themselves divine, yet this individual chose truth over comfort, and devotion over safety. Today, your task is to discover who this courageous soul was, whose story remains one of the most powerful examples of unwavering faith.
clues: I lived in a place of immense wealth and unmatched grandeur, where the ruler of the land held absolute power over all.
While those around me bowed to false gods, I kept a quiet light of faith within my heart.
I discovered and adopted a child who was brought to me in an unusual way - not by birth, but through the waters of a great river.
I prayed to my Lord, asking for a home near Him in Paradise and salvation from the tyranny that surrounded me.
The child I raised grew up to challenge the very ruler who controlled my fate, and I stood firm in my faith even when threatened.
I am the one whose name is honored in the Quran as a model of faith, and I lived in the palace of Pharaoh himself.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh
Maryam, the mother of Isa
Bilqis, the Queen of Sheba
The wife of Prophet Lut
The wife of Imran

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Discovering and raising an abandoned infant who became a great prophet
Being cast into a great fire by a tyrant
Witnessing a great flood that destroyed a people
Witnessing a date palm shake and provide nourishment
Conceiving a son despite advanced age
trial.answer: Discovering and raising an abandoned infant who became a great prophet

options: A royal palace of unmatched splendor

A garden enclosed by walls
location.answer: A royal palace of unmatched splendor

outcome.label: Outcome
options: A home was granted in Paradise by the will of Allah
A great flood destroyed the disbelievers of an ancient nation
A kingdom of immense power and authority was granted in this world
A mighty army was scattered by birds in flight
A tyrant who claimed divinity was drowned in the sea
outcome.answer: A home was granted in Paradise by the will of Allah

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
